title: Growing Popularity of "Buy Now Pay Later" Schemes and Plans to Regulate Firms Offering such Schemes
what_it_is: Growing Popularity of "Buy Now Pay Later" Schemes and Plans to Regulate Firms Offering such Schemes

sections.label: BNPL transaction size and risk
sections.summary: BNPL transactions totalled around $440 million last year, under 0.5% of $103 billion in card payments, and currently pose no significant consumer indebtedness risks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Last year, BNPL transactions amounted to around $440 million, which is less than 0.5% of the $103 billion in credit and debit card payments.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: BNPL schemes offered in Singapore, currently, do not pose significant risks of consumer indebtedness.

sections.label: MAS monitoring and industry code
sections.summary: MAS is monitoring BNPL, and the Singapore FinTech Association launched a working group to develop a code of conduct expected in the second half of this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: In fact, those who are 25 years or older account for more than 85% of BNPL users here and more than 90% of total BNPL transaction values.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: MAS is, nonetheless, closely monitoring the BNPL sector as such borrowings have the potential to grow rapidly.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: For now, MAS has assessed that effective industry self-regulation, through an industry code, should adequately mitigate the risks in the BNPL sector.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Under MAS’ guidance, the Singapore FinTech Association has launched a BNPL Working Group to develop a code of conduct for all BNPL providers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: This code, which we expect will be launched in the second half of this year, will seek to mitigate the risk of consumer over-indebtedness and establish minimum safeguards to ensure that consumer interests are well-protected while using BNPL schemes.

sections.label: Code safeguards against over-indebtedness
sections.summary: The code of conduct is expected to include minimum safeguards for BNPL providers to limit financial imprudence and mitigate consumer over-indebtedness risks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: In addition, we also expect the code of conduct to incorporate minimum safeguards for BNPL providers to limit financial imprudence amongst individuals and also to mitigate risks of consumer over-indebtedness.
